review.note: The date, Proclamation 733, 34 Stat. 3304 and Theodore Roosevelt are confirmed, and it did add land. But the proclamation does not order a name change: it already calls the reserve "Lewis and Clark" and notes the old spelling. The spelling changed some time between June 9, 1903 and March 2, 1907, by an instrument not found. Safe wording: "Land added (Proclamation 733); first proclamation to use the spelling Lewis and Clark."
